description: SimuNPS is Keliang’s power-system modelling and simulation software family. The provider lists electrical steady-state, electromagnetic transient, multi-time-domain and frequency-domain tools, together with model construction and analysis products. The provider is Shanghai Keliang Information Technology. Coverage: The software is intended for user-defined electricity systems. The provider claims time-scale coverage from nanoseconds to minutes across the family; this is not a verified capability of every individual product. Access: The provider’s software-family page and named product links were read. No trial was requested and no software was obtained. Licence and cost: The provider offers its own software products through trial and contact routes. Price, source-code rights and detailed licence conditions were not established. Limitations: Performance statements are provider claims. Product entitlements, numerical limits and validation evidence require separate checking. For simulation it provides engineering tools for power-system behaviour and grid-integration studies. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers this named SimuNPS software family.
